# yl-toggle Server Side SDK for Rust

[![Top Language](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/top/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust)](https://github.com/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust/search?l=rust)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust/branch/main/graph/badge.svg?token=TAN3AU4CK2)](https://codecov.io/gh/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust)
[![Github Star](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust)](https://github.com/yl-toggle/server-sdk-rust/stargazers)
[![Apache-2.0 license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yl-toggle/yl-toggle)](https://github.com/yl-toggle/yl-toggle/blob/main/LICENSE)

[yl-toggle](https://yl-toggle.com/) is an open source feature management service. This SDK is used to control features in rust programs. This
SDK is designed primarily for use in multi-user systems such as web servers and applications.

## Basic Terms

Reading the short [Introduction](https://docs.yl-toggle.io/reference/sdk-introduction) will help to understand the code blow more easily.  [中文](https://docs.yl-toggle.io/zh-CN/reference/sdk-introduction)

## How to use this SDK
See [SDK Doc](https://docs.yl-toggle.io/how-to/Server-Side%20SDKs/rust-sdk) for detail. [中文](https://docs.yl-toggle.io/zh-CN/how-to/Server-Side%20SDKs/rust-sdk)

## Contributing

We are working on continue evolving yl-toggle core, making it flexible and easier to use.
Development of yl-toggle happens in the open on GitHub, and we are grateful to the
community for contributing bugfixes and improvements.

Please read [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/yl-toggle/yl-toggle/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for details on our code of conduct, and the process for taking part in improving yl-toggle.
